text: All right, here's what I'm thinking. I'm thinking we might want a multi-level assistant process. And it's essentially merging the idea of an assistant and a mastermind. So each assistant could potentially make decisions on its own to fire off some task or to communicate with a particular mastermind. Now, I think what we want is, well, no, we don't want all the masterminds running all prompts through them. So the assistant would talk to the mastermind, I think the assistant might be able to spawn its own. I still don't know how the assistant is talking to the mastermind. Is it doing a poll?
